Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.477 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Risiya, District Bahraich.

3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant three years ago and subsequently, on 04.11.2023, she was hanged to death by the entire matrimonial family.
The cause of death, as per the postmortem report, is ante mortem hanging and apart from a ligature mark, no other injury is visible.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

Considering the postmortem report coupled with the fact that there is no specific assertion against the applicant who is the mother-in-law of causing any mental or physical harassment in relation to demand of dowry soon before the death, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Kanti Devi be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
